rear_expansion_at_origin.accounting: Full rear potential is inserted once. Its constant deflection and Hessian are not separately added again; U is a re-estimated remainder, not the former total environment.

Sluse_H0LiCOW_II_section4_1.alias: Sluse G1 = Morgan/Fadely G22; Sluse G1 is not Fadely main-lens G1

G1_identity_and_coordinates.east_sign_check: Fadely Table1 image A has x=-1.165,y=+.573 about the main light center, whereas adopted east/north NIC2 A is +1.1706,+.5665; x must flip, y must not. G22 is then east=-2.585,north=-3.637.
G1_identity_and_coordinates.center_ray_check: Physical G1 center is the measured G1 line of sight propagated to z=.7821 through the foreground lens. The rear potential cannot lens its own observed light before that emission plane.

required_interpretation: Gaia is now consumed development data; the small fitted Gaia residual is not held-out validation.
Finite rear Plummer scale .2kpc and its fitted mass are a conditional positive total-matter surrogate, not a uniquely inferred G1 physical state.
The R1 branch solves the foreground total two-Plummer radial source equation once. It does not solve an R1 scalar source/state for G1 or a globally coupled nonlinear environmental scalar domain.
The remaining U is an optical boundary term. Its two-dimensional Hessian does not supply the unresolved three-dimensional scalar environment or microscopic UV/state kernel.
The same observed G1 centroid is held fixed in the two model applications; its inferred physical center changes with foreground deflection. Do not call that strict fixed physical rear geometry.

The quadratic remainder and positive G1 are one reparameterized environmental potential with all nuisance coefficients fitted in development; do not add G1 to a retained complete former environment and claim unchanged total optical boundary.

A nonsymmetric multi-plane image Jacobian is expected from noncommuting Hessians; do not symmetrize it. The independent full action in both plane positions remains scalar and has symmetric full Hessian.
Provisional optical computation has physical_admission=false and leaves the 2e-10 physical guard unchanged.
